verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of invitee-initiated rescheduling or cancellation from a confirmation, nor any statement about policy enforcement or calendar sync on such changes. While this is a plausible feature for a scheduling product like SavvyCal, no documentation, webhook event, or feature page in the pack addresses it. Missing for 10: any mention of reschedule/cancel links in confirmations, policy enforcement on changes, or calendar update propagation across all attendees.
